items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interesting thing about Rambo is that Sylvester Stallone did a picture, a big, big mega-hit called Rambo that had nothing to do with my title Rambo.

ctx.x: The interesting thing about Rambo is that Sylvester Stallone did a picture, a big, big mega-hit called Rambo that had nothing to do with my title Rambo.
It would have been nice if they used your music. You would be a zillionaire by now.
